rules.sentence: Wall thickness greater than 5 mm suggests RVH.
Diagnostic testing is indicated whenever pulmonary hypertension is suspected.
Diagnostic testing confirms pulmonary hypertension, determines its severity, and identifies its cause.
An echocardiogram nonindicative of pulmonary hypertension should prompt diagnostic evaluation guided by clinical considerations.
Right heart catheterization (RHC) is warranted if suspicion for pulmonary hypertension persists despite echocardiographic findings.
